lines.say: [grim] To kill a billion Tyranids, the Deathwatch needed just one of them. Alive.
lines.text: TO KILL A BILLION TYRANIDS, THE DEATHWATCH NEEDED JUST ONE OF THEM. ALIVE.

lines.say: [cold, old voice] Bring me a Lictor. Breathing.
[grim] You'd think the Deathwatch only kills xenos. The smart ones study them first.
lines.text: YOU'D THINK THE DEATHWATCH ONLY KILLS XENOS. THE SMART ONES STUDY THEM FIRST.

lines.say: [grim] From its genes, a Magos brewed a poison. One dose. For the Norn Queen.
lines.text: FROM ITS GENES, A MAGOS BREWED A POISON. ONE DOSE. FOR THE NORN QUEEN.

lines.say: [grim] But she hid inside the last hive ship. And their captain, Bannon, had already died taking another.
lines.text: BUT SHE HID INSIDE THE LAST HIVE SHIP. AND THEIR CAPTAIN, BANNON, HAD ALREADY DIED TAKING ANOTHER.

lines.say: [steady, commanding] Then we board. I lead.
[low, tense] Imagine it. The corridors breathe. The walls are hungry.
lines.text: IMAGINE IT. THE CORRIDORS BREATHE. THE WALLS ARE HUNGRY.

lines.say: [tense] Acid on the floor. Keep moving.
lines.text: ACID ON THE FLOOR. KEEP MOVING.

lines.say: [grim] One shot of poison. And the swarm lost its mind, and tore itself apart.
lines.text: ONE SHOT OF POISON. AND THE SWARM LOST ITS MIND, AND TORE ITSELF APART.

lines.say: [quiet, grim] That is the Deathwatch. To kill a billion... you start with one.
lines.text: THAT IS THE DEATHWATCH. TO KILL A BILLION... YOU START WITH ONE.

drone: deep ominous space drone with distant organic groans of a giant alien creature
hiss: alien creature hissing and clicking, wet, menacing
bolter: three heavy bolter gun shots, loud, sci-fi
heartbeat: huge slow organic heartbeat echoing in a flesh cavern
drip: acid dripping and sizzling on metal armour
boom: massive muffled explosion in space with deep rumble
screech: monstrous alien queen screech, huge, echoing
page: comic book page turn, paper swoosh
servo: power armour servo whirr and heavy metal footstep
bell: single distant cathedral bell toll, sombre

music: dark grimdark orchestral ambient, low choir, slow war drums, tense strings building to a sombre end, instrumental, no vocals, sci-fi gothic
